'''Dragan S. Hajduković''' ([[Cyrillic]]: Драган С. Хајдуковић; born 11 June{{fact|date=September 2024}} 1949 in [[Cetinje]], [[Socialist Republic of Montenegro|PR Montenegro]], [[Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia|FPR Yugoslavia]]{{fact|date=September 2024}}), is a [[Montenegro|Montenegrin]] physics professor, astrophysicist and physicist, employed to [[CERN]], environmental activist and [[perennial candidate]]. 

In 2002 he became one of the founders of the Montenegrin green politics NGO and later political party [[Greens of Montenegro]].

Hajduković was a candidate for the [[President of Montenegro]] four times, firstly in [[1997 Montenegrin presidential election|1997 election]], then in [[2002 Montenegrin presidential election|December 2002]] and [[February 2003 Montenegrin presidential election|February 2003]], both elections were declared invalid due to low turnout,<ref>[http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/2742427.stm Montenegro poll fails] BBC News, 9 February 2003</ref> and finally in [[February 2003 Montenegrin presidential election|May 2003]], when he won the third place with 4.4% of votes. Hajduković had announced that he would run for president again in [[2008 Montenegrin presidential election|April 2008]], as well in [[2018 Montenegrin presidential election|April 2018]],<ref>[http://www.vijesti.me/vijesti/hajdukovic-kandidovacu-se-za-predsjednika-970830 Hajduković: Kandidovaću se za predsjednika] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181118124957/http://www.vijesti.me/vijesti/hajdukovic-kandidovacu-se-za-predsjednika-970830 |date=2018-11-18 }}, Vijesti</ref> but both times he did not manage to collect enough signatures to become an official candidate.<ref>[http://www.pcnen.com/portal/2018/03/26/hajdukovic-odustao-od-predsjednicke-kandidature/ Hajduković odustao od predsjedničke kandidature], PCNEN, 26 March 2018</ref>
